name: Mirtazapine
effects: Reduces depressive and anxious symptoms via alpha-2 antagonism and 5-HT2A/5-HT3 blockade
Paradox: MORE sedating at lower doses (15 mg) due to dominant H1 antihistamine effect; higher doses (30–45 mg) are activating due to noradrenergic increase
Significant appetite stimulation and weight gain — useful in anorexic/cachectic patients
Effective antiemetic (5-HT3 antagonism) — sometimes used in palliative care
Minimal sexual dysfunction and GI side effects
Agranulocytosis (rare but serious — monitor for infection symptoms)
Sedation makes it useful as a hypnotic
